units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: The identity of a participant in administrative offence proceedings participating in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system shall be established using information technology tools enabling identification of a person without their physical presence (the unified identification and authentication system and the unified biometric system).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.16 · “The identity of a participant in administrative offence…”

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 2. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case shall obtain from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters participating in consideration of the case through the Unified Portal a written acknowledgement that their rights and duties have been explained and that they have been warned of liability for failure to perform them, which shall be submitted to the court, body or official electronically, including in the form of an electronic document. Such an acknowledgement produced in the form of an electronic document shall be signed with a simple electronic signature.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 3. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system where:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 4. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a judge, body or official considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.16

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 29.1. LEGAL ASSISTANCE IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.label: Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.label: Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 1. Where procedural actions provided for by this Code need to be performed in the territory of a foreign state, the official conducting proceedings in the administrative offence case shall send a request for legal assistance to the relevant official or body of the foreign state in accordance with an international treaty of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, which shall be presumed unless proved otherwise.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 2. A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases shall be sent through:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 1) the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation — on matters concerning the judicial activities of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 2) repealed. — Federal Law of 04.06.2014 No. 143-ФЗ;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 3) the Ministry of Justice of the Russian Federation — on matters connected with the judicial activities of courts, except in the cases specified in point 1 of this part;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 4) the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation and the Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation — in relation to procedural actions concerning their administrative activities;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 5) the body authorised under an international treaty of the Russian Federation on legal assistance to send and receive requests connected with implementation of the relevant international treaty;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 6) the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation — in other cases.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
units.text: 3. A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases and the documents attached to it shall be accompanied by a certified translation into the official language of the requested state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.1.1

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.label: Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.label: Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases shall be drawn up in writing, signed by the official sending it, certified with the official seal bearing the coat of arms of the relevant body, and shall contain:
units.label: Art. 29.1.2 · “A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases…”

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 1) the name of the body issuing the request for legal assistance;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 2) the name and location of the body to which the request for legal assistance is sent;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 3) the designation of the administrative offence case and the nature of the request for legal assistance;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 4) particulars of the persons in respect of whom the request for legal assistance is sent, including their date and place of birth, citizenship, occupation, place of residence or stay, and, for legal entities, their name and location;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 5) a statement of the circumstances to be clarified and a list of the documents, physical evidence and other evidence requested;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
units.text: 6) information on the factual circumstances of the administrative offence committed, its legal classification, the text of the relevant Article of this Code, and, where necessary, information on the amount of harm caused by that offence.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 29.1.2

units.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
units.label: Art. 29.1.3

units.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
units.label: Art. 29.1.3

units.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: Evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state by its officials while executing a request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases, or sent to the Russian Federation as an attachment to a request to undertake administrative prosecution in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, certified and transmitted in the established manner, shall have the same legal force as if it had been obtained in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements of this Code.
units.label: Art. 29.1.3 · text

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation may, with their consent, be summoned by the official handling the administrative offence case to participate in procedural actions in the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. A request to summon a person shall be sent in accordance with the procedure established by part 2 of Article 29.1.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. Procedural actions involving persons specified in part 1 of this Article who have appeared in response to a summons shall be performed in accordance with the procedure established by this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. Persons specified in part 1 of this Article who have appeared in response to a summons may not, in the territory of the Russian Federation, be charged as accused persons, taken into custody or subjected to other restrictions on personal liberty for acts committed or on the basis of judgments delivered before those persons crossed the State Border of the Russian Federation. That guarantee shall cease to apply if a person who has appeared in response to a summons, having had the opportunity to leave the territory of the Russian Federation before expiry of a continuous period of 15 days from the moment they were officially notified that their presence was no longer required by the official who summoned them, remains in that territory or returns to the Russian Federation after leaving.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. A person held in custody in the territory of a foreign state shall be summoned in accordance with the procedure established by this Article provided that the person is temporarily transferred to the territory of the Russian Federation by the competent body or official of the foreign state to perform the actions specified in the request to summon the person. That person shall remain in custody throughout their stay in the territory of the Russian Federation, with the relevant decision of the competent body of the foreign state serving as the basis for custody. The person shall be returned to the territory of the relevant foreign state within the periods specified in the response to the request to summon the person. The conditions for transfer or refusal of transfer shall be determined by international treaties of the Russian Federation or written undertakings concerning cooperation on the basis of reciprocity.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.1.4

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A court and officials of federal executive authorities shall execute requests for legal assistance in administrative offence cases received from the relevant competent bodies and officials of foreign states and transmitted to them in the established manner, in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, which shall be presumed unless proved otherwise.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The provisions of this Code shall apply when executing a request for legal assistance. Where the request asks for application of procedural provisions of the legislation of a foreign state, the official executing the request shall apply the legislation of that foreign state provided that its application does not conflict with the legislation of the Russian Federation and is practicable.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. Representatives of a foreign state may be present during execution of a request for legal assistance if this is provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation or written undertakings concerning cooperation on the basis of reciprocity.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. If a request for legal assistance cannot be executed in full or in any part, the documents received shall be returned, stating the reasons that prevented its execution, through the body that received it or through diplomatic channels to the competent body of the foreign state from which the request originated.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. A request for legal assistance shall be returned in full or in any part where:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) it conflicts in full or in any part with the legislation of the Russian Federation or the international treaty of the Russian Federation under which it was sent;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) execution of the request in full or in any part may prejudice the sovereignty or security of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) similar requests from state bodies of the Russian Federation are not executed in the foreign state on the basis of reciprocity.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 29.1.5

units.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
units.text: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
units.label: Art. 29.1.6

units.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
units.label: Art. 29.1.6

units.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
units.text: Where an administrative offence is committed in the territory of the Russian Federation by a foreign legal entity or a foreign citizen who subsequently leaves that territory, and procedural actions involving that entity or person cannot be performed in the territory of the Russian Federation, all materials of the initiated administrative offence case under investigation shall be transferred to the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation, which shall decide whether to forward them to the competent bodies of the foreign state for administrative prosecution.
units.label: Art. 29.1.6 · text

units.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.7

units.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 29.1.7

units.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: A request from a competent body of a foreign state for administrative prosecution of a citizen of the Russian Federation who committed an administrative offence in the territory of the foreign state and returned to the Russian Federation, or of a Russian legal entity that committed an administrative offence outside the territory of the Russian Federation, shall be considered by the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation. Proceedings in the administrative offence case and consideration of the case in such circumstances shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure established by this Code.
units.label: Art. 29.1.7 · text

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case may be appealed against by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) if issued by a judge, to a higher court;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) if issued by a collegiate body, to the district court at the location of that collegiate body;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) if issued by an official, to a higher body, a higher-ranking official or the district court at the place where the case was considered;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.1) if issued by an official specified in part 2 of Article 23.79, part 2 of Article 23.79.1 or part 2 of Article 23.79.2 of this Code, to a higher body, a higher-ranking official, the federal executive body authorised by the relevant regulatory legal act of the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation or an agreement on the transfer of the exercise of certain powers, or the district court at the place where the case was considered;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) if issued by another body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to the district court at the place where the case was considered.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 30.1
